changeSet.author: Kiran Kumar

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM notifications_v2.notification_modes WHERE id=1 AND code='email'

changeSet.comment: Reuse notification_target_emails. Only email deliveries may omit user_id; keep registered-user uniqueness and add address uniqueness for email-only recipients. Mode 1 is the seeded email mode.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE notifications_v2.notification_deliveries ADD CONSTRAINT notification_deliveries_external_email_check CHECK (user_id IS NOT NULL OR (mode_id=1 AND jsonb_typeof(destination_snapshot->'email')='string' AND length(btrim(destination_snapshot->>'email'))>0) IS TRUE); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notification_deliveries_external_email_key ON notifications_v2.notification_deliveries(event_id,mode_id,(destination_snapshot->>'email')) WHERE user_id IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX notifications_v2.notification_deliveries_external_email_key; ALTER TABLE notifications_v2.notification_deliveries DROP CONSTRAINT notification_deliveries_external_email_check;
